body:
Complete-model ingestion needs configuration, tokenizer and license data in addition to converted tensors. Add `author.sources.ingest_huggingface(repository, revision=...)`, backed by a reviewed model-owned recipe and the existing retained native source/download/conversion calls. A memoized `prepare_model` builtin binds the retained model receipt and metadata tree, verifies the exact source census and metadata hashes, and attaches the configuration without rewriting tensor values. Upload and release publication stay separate.

The first recipe is the reviewed immutable Qwen Image 2.1 source; unknown models and unreviewed Qwen revisions refuse before native download. Model-specific configuration and census stay in `models/qwen_image21/ingestion.py`, with no inference/Torch imports. `model-ingestion-plan` exposes this inert reviewed selection to Creator for preflight. Both captured builtin exports use their exact descriptor and ordinary model/byte grants.

Validation: 17 focused tests pass including CLI recipe refusal, native wrong-census binding, static/dynamic builtin descriptor parity, carrier validation, process exit and reconnect ownership. The broader native source/quantization set had 38 passing and 6 skipped; its one old single-export expectation was corrected and its focused rerun passed. Mypy passes all 7 changed functional modules and Ruff passes. Creator's real Qwen dry-run verifies the reviewed headers and all 10 metadata hashes.

Integration: Creator #652 consumes this API. Release versioning is intentionally left to the coordinated 0.18.23 cohort. Full standard-command rented upload remains a live qualification gate; no paid resources or services were changed here. Closes #588.
